title: Summit Route Qualifying Bonus Schedule for Retro-Credited Segments
content:
A retro-credited segment in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program earns a route qualifying bonus according to the itinerary class of the segment's ticket, as the ticket's record under the Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand charter shows it.

| Itinerary class of the segment's ticket | Route qualifying bonus (USD) |
|---|---|
| Long-haul international | 150 |
| Short-haul international | 60 |
| Domestic | None |

**Notes**

1. The bonus is a flat amount added to the qualifying dollars the segment posts.
2. It does not depend on the fare, the fare brand or the member's tier.
3. Hypothetical reading: a segment whose posting stands at 1100.55 USD before this bonus reaches 1250.55 USD on a long-haul international ticket and 1160.55 USD on a short-haul international ticket; on a domestic ticket it stays at 1100.55 USD.
